description: Defines the 'byte_buffer_segment' class for managing byte spans with headroom, payload, and tailroom, including methods for appending, prepending, resizing, and trimming.

classes.name: byte_buffer_segment
classes.description: Manages a segmented byte buffer with support for headroom, payload, and tailroom, allowing modifications like append, prepend, resize, and trim.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns total storage capacity of the segment.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the segment has no payload.

methods.name: headroom
methods.description: Returns available space at the beginning of the segment.

methods.name: tailroom
methods.description: Returns available space at the end of the segment.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns reference to the last byte of the payload.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to the payload data.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the payload, uninitialized if larger.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends bytes or a single byte to the tail.

methods.name: trim_head
methods.description: Removes bytes from the start of payload.

methods.name: trim_tail
methods.description: Removes bytes from the end of payload.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of payload.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of payload.
